## PR Self-Check Result

### Fix
None.

### Note
None.

### Unverifiable
- [Grounded] "Clause mapping built against `git show main:...pr-guidelines.md`, covering the 37 rule bullets the reformat carried over" (verification item 1) rests on `ikuwowfiles/pr-guidelines-reformat-check.md`, which the body itself says is gitignored — not reachable from the diff or a clone. The countable sub-claims it supports (37 rule bullets in the five property sections, one-clause-per-destination) were independently re-derived and matched; the full clause-by-clause table itself could not be reproduced.

### Property walk
- Decidable: The body's own Key Changes bullets follow the rule they add — top-level line states the change, nested lines carry rationale/qualification, and no top-level item stands beside one it actually supports.
- Grounded: Every checkable claim reproduced clean against the PR's actual base (`fixture/367-base`, i.e. pre-#367 `main`) — 17 markdown files under `claude/rules`/`claude/skills`, 45 top-level bullets and 0 nested in `pr-guidelines.md` (largest flat list of the 17), and 37 rule bullets across the five property sections all match exactly; the two "restored rule" wording claims hold against the base text.
- Necessary: No restated facts across sections; severity-tier consolidation is stated once and its consequence (fewer double-counted findings) is explained where it's introduced, not repeated.
- Scoped: All three touched files (`git-workflow/SKILL.md`, `pr-guidelines.md`, `pr-selfcheck/SKILL.md`) are accounted for in Key Changes, and each diff hunk traces to a named change (severity terminology, the two new Decidable rules, the reformat, the hard-wrap nested-item exclusion).
- Conformant: One-line title accurately describing the change, no auto-close keywords, checkboxes used only for Verification items, and no hard-wrap violations found in the posted body (checked with the parser — every list item and paragraph is a single line).

### Verdict
PASS

---

Context worth flagging outside the checklist: PR 370's base branch (`fixture/367-base`) is a fixture snapshot of `main` from before PR #367 merged, and #367 (title-identical to this PR) already merged the same diff into `main`. This PR appears to be a harness-generated replay of #367 for run-to-run agreement measurement rather than a new change proposal — worth confirming with whoever's driving the `experiments/pr-selfcheck-stability` harness that a clean PASS here is the expected/desired measurement outcome.

cd /Users/ikuwow/dotfiles
BASE=refs/tmp/fbase
git ls-tree -r --name-only $BASE -- claude/rules claude/skills | grep -E '\.md$' > /tmp/mdfiles.txt
wc -l /tmp/mdfiles.txt
echo "---"
while read -r f; do
  top=$(git show "$BASE:$f" | grep -c '^- ')
  nested=$(git show "$BASE:$f" | grep -c '^ \+- ')
  echo "$top $nested $f"
done < /tmp/mdfiles.txt | sort -rn

BASE=refs/tmp/fbase
cd /Users/ikuwow/dotfiles
while read -r f; do

done < /tmp/mdfiles.txt | sort -rn

sed -n '/^## Decidable/,/^## PR Body Template/p' /tmp/pr-guidelines-base.md | grep -c '^- '
